{{Top|leg}}
The '''office of Senator Kameron Suldar''' in the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] was used by the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]] [[Ivaar Workan]], who posed as [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] Suldar of the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[B'nish]] during the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] infiltration of Coruscant. The office was furnished with a [[wurlwood]] door, a glass desk, and display cases that contained glass sculptures from Workan's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. Workan's [[senatorial aide]] was [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lady]] [[Enara Massar]].

The High Lord's personal office contained a room that served as his [[Meditation/Legends|meditation]] chamber, featuring his longtime favorite glass sculptures and a mat with a [[Candle/Legends|candle]] on one side of the room; the other side had a desk and a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] that Workan used to communicate with the Sith Tribe's [[Grand Lord]], [[Darish Vol]]. Workan's [[Sleeper (furniture)|bedroom]] also had a chair with an activation button for [[Viewscreen/Legends|vidcalls]].
